body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes ES module directory import errors in the `@object-ui/core` package by removing `/index.js` suffixes from directory re-exports. The issue was causing test failures because ES modules do not support directory imports - TypeScript was emitting directory imports when re-exporting with the `/index.js` suffix.

**Changes:**
- Updated export statements in `packages/core/src/index.ts` to remove `/index.js` suffix from directory re-exports (`types`, `validation`, `evaluator`, `actions`, `query`)
- Updated export statement in `packages/core/src/validation/index.ts` to remove `/index.js` suffix from `validators` directory re-export

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/core/src/index.ts | Removed `/index.js` suffix from 5 directory re-exports (types, validation, evaluator, actions, query) while maintaining `.js` extension for direct file exports |
| packages/core/src/validation/index.ts | Removed `/index.js` suffix from validators directory re-export while maintaining `.js` extension for direct file exports |
